items.sentence_en: Most of the students in the class agreed with Tom.
items.sentence_vi: Hầu hết học sinh trong lớp đều đồng tình với Tom.
items.phonetic: moʊst əv ðə ˈstudənts ɪn ðə klæs əˈgrid wɪθ tɑm.

items.sentence_en: I think you\'ve put your sweatshirt on inside out.
